title: fix(dispatcher): radio records write timestamps where route artifacts owe dates
description:
## .what

`radio.task.push` writes route records (`$route/.radio/record.*.json`) whose `heldAt` and
`settledAt` carry full iso timestamps (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ`).

## .why it hurts

route artifacts must carry dates only (rule.forbid.timestamps-in-route-artifacts): time
precision is false precision and makes merge conflicts. repos that enforce it with a
pre-commit hook refuse to commit the radio's own record, so a driver must hand-edit each
record to a date before every commit.

## .the shape of the fix

1. write `heldAt` / `settledAt` as `YYYY-MM-DD` (as `pushedAt` already renders on stdout)
2. where order within a day matters, order by a monotonic counter in the record, never a clock
3. clamp: a test that pushes one task and asserts each date field of the record matches
   `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$`

## .found

rhachet-roles-bhrain @ beav/feat-review-cost-meter, 2026-10-16; the commit hook refused
`.radio/record.26e117763d6eba64.json` until both fields were cut to a date by hand.
